#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    void exec() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;

        vector<int> poly(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x;
            cin >> x;
            poly[x] = 1;
        }

        vector<int> result = {1};
        int exponent = n / 2;

        const int MOD = 998244353;

        while (exponent > 0) {
            if (exponent & 1) {
                result = convolute(result, poly, MOD);
            }
            poly = convolute(poly, poly, MOD);
            exponent >>= 1;
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int val : result) {
            answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
        }
        cout << answer << endl;
    }

    vector<int> convolute(vector<int> p, vector<int> q, int mod) {
        int len = p.size() + q.size() - 1;
        int n = 1;
        while (n < len) n <<= 1;
        if (n < 2) n = 2;

        vector<double> pr(n, 0.0), pi(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < p.size(); i++) {
            long long x = (p[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            pr[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            pi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        transform(pr, pi, false);

        vector<double> qr(n, 0.0), qi(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < q.size(); i++) {
            long long x = (q[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            qr[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            qi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        transform(qr, qi, false);

        vector<double> cr(n, 0.0), ci(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> dr(n, 0.0), di(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (pr[i] + pr[j]) * 0.5;
            double a1i = (pi[i] - pi[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2r = (pi[i] + pi[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2i = (pr[j] - pr[i]) * 0.5;

            double b1r = (qr[i] + qr[j]) * 0.5;
            double b1i = (qi[i] - qi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2r = (qi[i] + qi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2i = (qr[j] - qr[i]) * 0.5;

            cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
            dr[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            di[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        transform(cr, ci, true);
        transform(dr, di, true);

        vector<int> res(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            long long a = llround(cr[i]);
            long long b = llround(dr[i]);
            long long c = llround(ci[i]);
            res[i] = (int)((a + ((b % mod) << 15) + ((c % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void transform(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; j ^ bit; bit >>= 1) {
                j ^= bit;
                if (j < bit) break;
            }
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re[i], re[j]);
                swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int h = 2; h <= n; h <<= 1) {
            double ang = 2 * M_PI / h * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            double wH_re = cos(ang);
            double wH_im = sin(ang);

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += h) {
                double w_re = 1.0;
                double w_im = 0.0;
                for (int j = 0; j < h / 2; j++) {
                    double ur = re[i + j];
                    double ui = im[i + j];
                    double vr = re[i + j + h/2] * w_re - im[i + j + h/2] * w_im;
                    double vi = re[i + j + h/2] * w_im + im[i + j + h/2] * w_re;

                    re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                    im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                    re[i + j + h/2] = ur - vr;
                    im[i + j + h/2] = ui - vi;

                    double t_re = w_re * wH_re - w_im * wH_im;
                    w_im = w_re * wH_im + w_im * wH_re;
                    w_re = t_re;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.exec();
    return 0;
}
